#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    std::string result_str = "";
    bool used_at = false;
    size_t pos_idx = 0;
    while (pos_idx < s.length()) {
        if (pos_idx != 0 && pos_idx + 3 <= s.length() && s.substr(pos_idx, 3) == "dot") {
            result_str += '.';
            pos_idx += 2;
        } else if (pos_idx != 0 && pos_idx + 2 <= s.length() && !used_at && s.substr(pos_idx, 2) == "at") {
            result_str += '@';
            used_at = true;
            pos_idx += 1;
        } else {
            result_str += s[pos_idx];
        }
        pos_idx += 1;
    }
    std::cout << result_str << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
